text:
maya: quick sync — we need to finalize prioritization for the dedicated capacity roadmap (reserved pools + burst/autoscale) for the next launch window. can we lock a minimal scope for Q3?
andre: +1. what's the absolute must-have vs nice-to-have?
tess: must-have: reserve pools with stable billing and clear SLA tiers. nice-to-have: per-tenant soft-burst carryover.
sam: ops constraints: autoscale cooldown and graceful preempt policy are critical for SRE — otherwise oncall load spikes.
maya: propose MUST = (1) reserved pools (2) burst window with soft preempt (3) observability: per-pool latency & cost telemetry. NICE = carryover, predictive prewarm add-on, micro-pools.
lucas: for burst window, can we define a simple policy: 90s grace window + 2x baseline throughput for up to 10% of monthly commit? That keeps math tractable for billing.
andre: 90s sounds reasonable. 10% carry is higher than I expected — legal/sales will push. suggest 5% default, opt-up to 15% for enterprise.
tess: agreement mechanics: we need contract language for 'burst opt-up' and a UI flag in console. engineering effort: ~2 sprint days for UI + 1 sprint for backend rate-limiter.
ellie: telemetry checklist: token-level cost delta, headroom utilization, failover events. must have exportable CSV for customer audits.
ops-bot: deploy plan reminder: canary 10% traffic -> monitor latency percentiles for 48h -> rollback threshold p95 + 50ms increase.
maya: launch criteria draft: 1) SLAs implemented for reserved tiers, 2) burst policy enforced with opt-up flag, 3) console shows per-pool metrics, 4) billing delta validated on pilot customer (ACME).
sam: risk: preempt behavior could surface noisy neighbor issues. mitigation: default soft-preempt (degrade to lower-cost model) + priority lanes. we should add a small experiment to simulate noisy tenants.
lucas: scope negotiation note: postpone carryover to GA and ship as early-access. that reduces initial surface area.
andre: prioritization vote — ship MUST items this quarter, NICE items as EA/next quarter. +1 from me.
maya: action items: @tess own UI estimate, @sam own preempt experiment, @ellie spec telemetry events, @andre follow up on contract wording with sales/legal. I'll pull into a single roadmap PR.
tess: ack, I'll drop an ETA by end of day.
ellie: will list telemetry events and sample CSV schema by tomorrow.
maya: thanks — small follow-up: add a short note in the launch checklist about customer opt-in for burst opt-up (explicit consent).
andre: noted. :thumbsup:
maya: closing — will open the roadmap PR with these scoped MUSTs.
